findings.summary: The only production task-security issuer remains directly importable and signs caller-supplied state.
findings.required_fix: Move issuance to an application/storage-owned capability rooted in the immutable installed runtime pin and current repository state; ordinary installed-package callers must not mint trusted contexts from raw mappings.

findings.summary: The disclosure journal issuer signs an arbitrary caller-supplied receipt without reading a durable action journal.
findings.required_fix: Issue disclosure attestations only from a durable current action-journal entry bound to the action, plan, payload, destination, target receipt, and reconciliation state.

findings.summary: Retention freshness checks trust a caller-selected context instead of rereading current durable state.
findings.required_fix: Authorize purge in a repository transaction that rereads the latest subject revision, classification, holds, dependencies, and unresolved claims, then atomically consumes a one-use purge authorization.
